capabilities: Import selected Prismical notes or folders into a chosen vault folder
Synchronize note bodies in both directions manually or on a 60-second interval
Merge non-overlapping edits and queue overlapping changes for conflict review
Rename and move linked files while preserving unsent edits across restarts
Disconnect or reconnect individual notes without deleting local Markdown
extras: Desktop beta: one connector device per vault, no mobile, tags, attachments, transcripts, or local-to-remote note creation yet; manual installation required until listed in the community directory; sends note content and account identifiers to the Prismical API (server-side diagnostics, no client-side analytics).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring Prismical meeting notes into the vault and keep edits made in either app synchronized.

relations.evidence: Sync selected Prismical note bodies with Markdown files in Obsidian, in both directions.

summary: Two-way sync plugin that imports selected Prismical meeting notes as Markdown files and keeps edits in sync across both apps.
